# Ashutosh Sharma (DevBehindYou)

> Ashutosh Sharma, known online as **DevBehindYou**, is a full-stack web and
> Android developer from Agra, India. He builds web apps with React, Next.js and
> Node.js, Android apps with Flutter and Kotlin, and open-source UI libraries,
> and he builds in public: each repo records what is done and what is next.
> Signature line: *"I build it. I ship it. I show the work."*

Canonical page: https://devbehindyou.github.io/DevBehindYou/
Main site: https://devbehindyou.com/
GitHub: https://github.com/DevBehindYou
Contact: https://devbehindyou.com/contact or devbehindyou@gmail.com

This page is the developer showcase: projects, progress and code. Client case
studies, SEO and GEO services and results live on https://devbehindyou.com/.

## Numbers, read from the repos on October 7, 2026

- **41** public repositories
- **900+** automated tests across MDify (248), Atomic Notes (280), Atomic File Manager (238) and EKIP (134)
- **5** Android apps in the Atomic family: Atomic Notes, Atomic Vault, Atomic Assist, Atomic File Manager and Atomic Carton
- **318** commits on the Atomic Notes v0.3 rebuild across its app, server and site repos

## What he builds

- **Web apps:** React and Next.js front ends, Node.js and FastAPI services,
  MongoDB, Supabase Postgres, Redis and BullMQ, auth and role-based access,
  admin panels, and LLM features with retrieval and citations.
- **Android apps:** Flutter with BLoC or Riverpod, Kotlin with Jetpack Compose,
  local-first storage, Argon2id and AES-256-GCM vaults, the Android Keystore,
  biometric unlock, and signed release builds from GitHub Actions.
- **Open source:** MDify, Atomic Assist and the WPS/A Wi-Fi Tester (GPL-3.0 or
  AGPL-3.0), EKIP, ITAP, Atomic Vault and LiquidAccessories (MIT). Atomic Notes
  is source-available.
- **Search-ready builds:** server rendering, schema markup, sitemaps, llms.txt
  and Core Web Vitals checks, because his other job is technical SEO.

## How he works

Plan (spec, data model, screens), build in small phases, test in CI and on a
real device, then ship a tagged release with a README status section that says
what is verified and what is not.

## Projects in progress and shipped

- **Atomic Notes** (Flutter, Dart). Local-first notes for Android that sync to
  the user's own Google Drive, with an optional end-to-end vault. Shipped
  v2.03.5, roadmap 7 of 11 items done. Site: https://atomic-notes.devbehindyou.com/
  Code: https://github.com/DevBehindYou/Atomic-Notes-App-V0.2
- **Atomic Notes v0.3** (Flutter, TypeScript). The rebuild across an app, a sync
  server and a site. In development, not ready for use.
  Code: https://github.com/DevBehindYou/Atomic-Notes-App-V0.3
- **Atomic Assist** (Flutter, Riverpod, GPL-3.0). Local-first personal assistant
  with a day planner, focus timer and bring-your-own-key AI. Build phases 1 to 5
  and Export done. Code: https://github.com/DevBehindYou/FLOWLINE
- **Atomic File Manager** (Kotlin). Full file manager for Android, paused before
  release. Code: https://github.com/DevBehindYou/Refract-Full-File-Manager
- **Atomic Vault** (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MIT). Password vault with an
  encrypted database, autofill and a secure keyboard. Release v0.2.1.
  Code: https://github.com/DevBehindYou/Atomic-Vault-v0.2
- **MDify** (Next.js, Python, FastAPI, GPL-3.0). Free converter from PDF, Office,
  EPUB, image and ZIP files to clean Markdown. Live: https://mdify-app.vercel.app/
  Code: https://github.com/DevBehindYou/MDify
- **EKIP** (React, Node.js, MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, MIT). Enterprise
  knowledge assistant with a citation and confidence score on every answer.
  Live: https://ekip-project.vercel.app/
  Code: https://github.com/DevBehindYou/Enterprise-Knowledge-Intelligence-Platform-EKIP-Project
- **ITAP** (React, Node.js, FastAPI, MIT). Multi-tenant hiring platform with
  explainable match scores. Roadmap phases 1 and 2 done, most of phase 3.
  Live: https://itap-project.vercel.app/
  Code: https://github.com/DevBehindYou/Intelligent-Talent-Acquisition-Platform-ITAP-Project
- **NEXUS CRM** (Next.js, Express, MongoDB). Multi-tenant CRM with an AI Copilot.
  Live demo: https://nexus-crm-alpha-weld.vercel.app/ (code is private)
- **LiquidAccessories** (HTML, CSS, JS, MIT). Liquid Glass UI library with 76
  components. Code: https://github.com/DevBehindYou/LiquidAccessories
- **LiquidLens.** Liquid Glass for web, React, React Native, Flutter and SwiftUI.
  Code: https://github.com/DevBehindYou/LiquidLens
